title: Which Is Bigger: 3/4 or 5/6?
description: A visual way to compare two fractions with different denominators at a glance.
narration_lines: Which is bigger, three fourths or five sixths?
Split one bar into fourths, and another into sixths.
Fill in three of the fourths, and five of the sixths.
Five sixths leaves a smaller empty gap, so five sixths is the bigger fraction.

params.footnote: the smaller the empty gap, the bigger the fraction
